title: docs(pm-dispatch): clear the dissolved driver-freeze residue from the lane brief and the compile-surfaces table
body:
Part of #13089 — this PR delivers sites 1-2 of the four that card names. Sites 3-4 are deliberately absent; the "Sites 3-4" section below says why, and #13089 stays open to carry them.

Deliberately NOT a closing relation. The dispatch asked for one, on the assumption all four sites would land. Two did. Closing the card on merge would drop the other two silently, so the relation is `Part of`.

## The dissolution, corroborated on disk before any edit

Head note of `packages/spec/src/data/aggregation-conformance.ts:141-143`:

> Every row is struck through: the maintainer lifted the **#5499 investment freeze** for `driver-mongodb` on 2026-08-11 and for `driver-memory` later the same day, and both cells were enrolled rather than argued.

Two rulings, same day — which is the "two rulings on the anchor" the card names. Verified first; had it been absent this would have stopped.

## Site 1 — `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/engine.md`, 常设承诺

**Before** (lines 21-24):

> - **投入冻结随包不随车道**:维护者 2026-08-05 对 `driver-memory` / `driver-mongodb` 族的投入冻结继续有效;能穿过冻结的形状是「消除静默失败模式」与清账/对齐既有能力,形如**能力投资**的卡派发前须取裁决;`formula` / `driver-sql` 不受影响。

**After**: the bullet is gone. Pure drop, mirroring the precedent already set for the SKILL.md lane-table row — the anchor carries its own history, so a dissolution stub in the lane brief would re-state what the anchor already holds.

The 「能力投资的卡派发前须取裁决」 clause goes with it rather than being rescued: it was a rule OF the freeze regime (the second 2026-08-11 ruling retired the hold-on-filing triage rule it belonged to), and the four-facet decision frame already routes large investments to the maintainer, so nothing is lost. The surrounding 常设承诺 list keeps two bullets and needs no grammar stub.

## Site 2 — `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/compile-surfaces.md`, the 冻结 row

Kept as a row rather than dropped. Post-dissolution the row is not pointless — it inverted: it used to tell a PM "these two faces are out of scope", and the fact a PM now needs is the opposite one, that they are ordinary declarable faces. Dropping it would leave the two faces unmentioned in a table whose whole job is to be exhaustive, and the maintenance clause three lines below explicitly makes freeze-status changes this table's business.

**Before** (249 bytes):

> `| 冻结 | driver-memory / driver-mongodb | — | 维护者 2026-08-05 投入冻结:**pin-annotate,不翻转**。冻结面仍要申报,结论是「不在范围 + 冻结指令」。现场注释见 read-scope-sql.ts:176、having-filter.ts:41 |`

**After** (341 bytes):

> `| 已解冻 | driver-memory / driver-mongodb | packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-matcher.ts:134(checkCondition)、packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-filter.ts:700(translateFieldOperators) | 2026-08-05 投入冻结,**2026-08-11 两条裁决解除** ⇒ 「不在范围 + 冻结指令」作废,按普通面申报 |`

On the doubly-stale pointer: the old 落点 cell was `—` and the 备注 pointed at two freeze ANNOTATIONS, one of which (`read-scope-sql.ts:176`) had both a wrong path and a wrong line. Rather than repair a pointer to commentary, the row now carries what the 落点 column means in every other row of this table — where the face actually compiles. Both verified in this tree:

- `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-matcher.ts:134` — `function checkCondition`
- `packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-filter.ts:700` — `function translateFieldOperators`

That also makes the row independent of the two in-code annotations' state, which matters given they are not fixed here.

No issue numbers in either file (id-lint scans `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`); dates and quoted fragments only.

## Sites 3-4 — measured, then stopped, per the card's own triage instruction

The triage on #13089 gave a conditional: measure the divergence first; if it is still real post-lift, STOP and file it as a `domain:engine` card rather than rewriting the two comments over an actionable defect; if the faces are aligned, past-tensing the comments may stay in this card.

**Measured by execution**, not by reading, against `memory-matcher.ts` `match()` at merge-base `56470d86b`, on both readings of "no value" (`name: null` and key absent). Ruling answer (#5146 extended by #5298 option A, re-affirmed after #5299's reversal was costed and withdrawn) is `['2','3']`:

| Operator | `name: null` | key absent |
|---|---|---|
| `$ne` | `['2','3']` OK | `['2','3']` OK |
| `$nin` | `['2','3']` OK | **`['2']` DIVERGENT** |
| `$notContains` | **`['2']` DIVERGENT** | **`['2']` DIVERGENT** |

Three of six cells diverge — so the condition holds and the STOP applies. Split out as #13166 (`domain:engine`), which carries the mechanism and what such a repair owes.

The measurement also found the comment is wrong in a way neither the card nor the dispatch anticipated: `driver-mongodb` is NOT divergent on this family and never was (`$nin` maps straight through, `$notContains` compiles to `{ $not: { $regex } }`, both matching a missing field). So "the drivers answer the old way" could not have been past-tensed as written — it would have needed a fresh factual claim about which face diverges, which is a content judgement belonging on the engine card.

The harness used for this was deleted before the commit; the tree carries no trace of it.

| `references/compile-surfaces.md` | 26 | 26 | **0** | 26 | 0 | 352 bytes, pin 352 — unchanged |

Net **-4 lines**, no re-wrap anywhere, so nothing added is funded by re-flowing (SKILL.md governance row, maintainer 2026-08-17: 新增以删减付账). The one changed row grew 249 to 341 bytes but is not the file's widest (row 16 holds 352), so the byte pin is untouched.

**Cut ledger** — 4 lines, all one bullet at `lanes/engine.md:21-24`: the standing statement that the 2026-08-05 investment freeze on the `driver-memory` / `driver-mongodb` family 「继续有效」; the enumeration of shapes allowed through it (消除静默失败模式, 清账/对齐既有能力); the 「形如能力投资的卡派发前须取裁决」 clause; and the 「`formula` / `driver-sql` 不受影响」 carve-out. Nothing cut is recoverable only from here — the anchor holds the regime's history, and the four-facet frame holds the escalation rule.

`lanes/engine.md` is left with 4 lines of headroom rather than having its ceiling lowered to 36. Lowering is "legitimate and encouraged" by the ratchet's own discipline, but it edits `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, which adds that gate script's own test surface to a docs-only diff. Called out as an available follow-up rather than ridden in.

That is a not-measured result, not a red gate: it exits before running a check. Both packages were built and the gate then ran green, which is the reading reported above.

No changeset: the diff is entirely `.claude/**`, which is on the closed list. `skip-changeset` applied at PR open.

Governed-reference PR ⇒ draft only, no ready flip, no reviewers, no auto-merge.
